desc:
Welcome to Kittenville - a multiplayer asymmetrical horror game about cats, where teamwork is the key to survival and escape!
Take on the role of a Survivor or become the Hunter. Complete objectives, help your teammates, and find your way out before it's too late.

─ HUNTER VS SURVIVORS ─
✦ Work together to complete feeding stations and unlock the exits.
✦ Hunt down the Survivors and stop them from escaping.
✦ Survive the 8-minute match!

─ OPEN WORLD ─
✦ Take a break from survival and relax in the Open World! 🔮 Meet other players, hang out with friends, and trade your favorite cats!
✦ Collect unique cats, play minigames, and unlock exclusive skins available only in the Open World!
✦ The Open World unlocks after playing 5 matches.

─ HALLOWEEN EVENT ─
✦ Collect pumpkins 🎃, progress through the 100-level Battle Pass, and earn exclusive seasonal rewards!

⚠️ Hurry up: Every cat becomes exclusive with time.
